Tres Manifique! It is very good and worth the price, less than Keller's place with just as much oomph. Like the location, if you don't do Valet, you better plan on walking..to there. The duck es terrier. and what a menu! French food w/o the attitude. More than a Bistro. Incredible time with Le Spouse & accompaniments. This was worth the trip and wait. Thanks to all for reviewing this place, It just exceeds what you would think. Wines are also tres bien. What a list! Wow. Wanted to give it a five. Very few. San Francisco still wins. My Spouse did is own review for here. Just appreciate a great and quiet meal with friends. My other half had le poisson. For fish it was NOT overcooked/overbaked, it was juicy? But I did not try it as FISH is not por moi. He said it was really good. I would go back for sure. Merci! Rest. Republicque-great job.

We've been wanting to try this place for some time, but finally got her today. We parked in the valet (as there was no street parking) and went in.  The entry area is small and we were there at 11:30am and most of the pastries were sold out.  (get there early for the full selection) We studied the menu and ordered a couple of pasteries first.  That is how it works, you order your pastry selections from the case, while waiting in line for the cashier to take your food order.  We ordered a donut hole-like item that had a cream filling and a Passion Fruit cream cake.   For our food, we ordered a Cuban Sandwich and the Adobo Pork Fried Rice.  My wife ordered a cafe mocha and I appreciated that my iced tea was with bergamot. We took our table number (which was an old beat up tin cup - kind of fun) and found a table.  We were seated right at the indoor archways to the back dining room.  I enjoyed looking at the classic cathederal-like architecture while dining. Our food came and it was really good.  I had the Cuban Sandwich and it was probably the best I've every had.  My wife enjoyed her fried rice, but we both loved my salad that came with the sandwich. It was the best thing in the meal!  It was simple butter lettuce, but the home made dressing was unbelievably good, with fresh herbs. We also enjoyed the desserts we ordered, but I was more impressed with the lunch items.  That said the cream pie was tasty. We will be back as there are so many more dishes I'd like to try.

Everything was so good! My friends and I shared pastries, both savory and sweet. Raspberry scone and chicken Thai basil empanada- so good! We also got the breakfast sandwich, breakfast quesadilla, and the mushroom and avocado toast. Everything had very good flavor - would definitely come again!

I've been a loyal customer of Republique since 2015, when I first moved to the area. For over a decade, this was my go-to recommendation for friends and visitors. I've brought my parents here countless times, and now I come with my own family--my wife and kids. That loyalty made this morning's experience all the more disappointing. We asked the host for savory recommendations, and she suggested the burrito to share. At no point was it mentioned that the dish was extremely spicy. Having worked in the hospitality industry myself, I know that when you recommend something to a guest--especially something as spicy as this was--you mention it. That's basic service. But we weren't warned. The dish turned out to be far too spicy for our young son to enjoy. When we politely raised the issue with the manager, Christine, we were met with defensiveness rather than understanding. Christine's response? "It's written on the menu"--as if we were ridiculous for not reading the entire menu in detail after specifically asking for recommendations. But who does that? In all my years working in hospitality, I've never had a guest ask for recommendations and then read through the entire menu line by line. You trust the person giving you the recommendation. She also emphasized that "the majority of the meal was already eaten," making us feel guilty for even bringing it up. We had attempted to eat it before realizing it was simply inedible for our table--that's why we raised the concern. And it was not "majority", you can see the photo of the piece of the burrito that we took out of the whole! This whole interaction gave us a bad taste in our mouth that made us not want to finish even that piece. What struck me most was how the conversation unfolded. I approached her apologetically, genuinely sorry to be making any kind of request. That wasn't received--Christine was clearly annoyed from the start. When I told her I felt she was guilt-tripping us, she deflected rather than addressing the concern. She didn't ask if my wife and I might still want to keep the dish--she simply said she'd come by to take it away, which meant they would just toss it. It felt less like a resolution and more like a dismissal. My wife was equally upset by the interaction. The only time Christine's demeanor shifted was when I mentioned I would be leaving a review and asked for her name. Good customer service means listening to concerns and finding solutions, not making customers feel bad for asking. A simple acknowledgment--or an offer to help--would have turned this into a positive experience. Instead, we left feeling dismissed and unwelcome. After 11 years, I can no longer recommend Republique. Not because of one spicy dish, but because of how we were treated when we raised a concern. The food may be decent, but how you treat longtime customers when issues arise matters just as much--if not more. We won't be returning.

Stopped by for their cafe brunch with my four legged lunch date accompanying me in her stroller(restaurant closed on Monday).  They had a good selection for brunch and numerous options for delicious pastries so had to dabble a few and then bring them home to finish later.  The venue is also stunning with a slight rustic style with modern twist .  Felt like I was dining in a castle.  Outdoor seating also available especially if you have a service dog. Here's what I tried: 1.  Kimchi Fried Rice: served in a hot pan with bed of fried rice (white rice, kimchee, small pieces of rib bites-hardly any meat) with poached egg on top and garnished with herbs, pickled yellow radish, fresh red radish slices, and sesame seeds.  This dish was decent but nothing stellar. 2.  Also ordered an assortment of pastries...Ibe brioche (light brioche with ube cream that's not too sweet-good), pecan pistachio brioche (brioche filled with creamy white filling and topped with a thick layer of caramel mixed with loads of pecans and pistachios-this was good. It felt a bit too heavy on the caramel), carrot cake (standard carrot cake with some cream cheese-not bad), and the last one I'm not sure what they call it but it was delicious.  I'm calling it a coffee cake Bundt cake.  This one was my favorite.  Very fresh Bundt cake with creamy coffee frosting and crumbled coffee cake on top.  Soooo good. Would love the to try their restaurant menu when I get a chance.

What a great experience. From the beginning of service until the end. It was superb. I still can't wrap my head around that baguette and drippings! Absolutely phenomenal. I absolutely loved your play on a gin and tonic.  Last but not least, the brown butter cake with tangerine was sublime.

This place is not mind-blowing like some people make it out to be, but the brioche in the French toast was soft and pillowy with crispy edges and the ricotta toast had a nice balance between the cheese and fruit. Highly recommend sharing the French toast and going without the maple syrup because it can be heavy. The fruit on the ricotta toast is seasonal I believe? But the oranges on my toast were kind of odd next to the persimmon texture-wise, albeit providing a very satisfying color palette.

My friends and I decided to check this place out for brunch this past Sunday after seeing how beautiful the space was on social media and the variety of baked goods and food items they have. They don't take reservations for brunch, so we waited in line but, the line went by pretty fast. You basically make the line and enter the bakery area where you have the option to pick any baked goods and pay for them there or if you are ordering from the brunch menu, you have a separate counter to order and pay for your food and drinks. The place was packed when we arrived around 12:45 p.m. on a Sunday, but we were able to grab a seat at one of the communal tables upstairs. The service left a lot to be desired. It seemed like the staff had a hard time locating customers and delivering food efficiently, likely because it's a counter-service cafe rather than a traditional sit-down restaurant. My boyfriend and I ordered two fried chicken and waffles, an orange juice, a peach Bellini, and an ice latte, which totaled to $118 after a 20% tip, which I thought was excessive. The fried chicken was good but the corn gravy below it was too sweet and made the waffle soggy, which made it not so enjoyable. My peach bellini was also average. I did however enjoyed my vanilla latte. My friends ordered the fried chicken and waffles and the kimchi fried rice, which they also thought was average and overpriced. Overall, I would say that this place is overhyped by influencers, and not a place I'd most likely come back to.

It was my first time here ( I know, I know - late!) but it was  great experience. I loved the inside decor and seating option, I loved how they have forks and knives and napkins ready on the table, and I really loved my yuzu soda and potato salmon pancake looks like a small meal, but it's sooo good and very filling! Overall this was a great experience, and I will be returning!

I had brunch at Republique for the first time last Friday! I brought my friend and we had a tasty meal. We parked in the residential area nearby and arrived at Republique at around 10:45am. We ordered at the indoor counter, where there was a short queue, and we quickly found seating afterwards. We loved the ambiance of the place with the high ceilings and lively atmosphere. The service was fast and the staff were friendly. Their pricing was on the higher end, but as expected for a restaurant in west LA. We shared This Morning's Bread, which was simple, yet fresh. The bread was still crisp, and the butter & jam spread nicely. My entree was the Shakshouka, which was colorful and tangy from the tomatoes; and filling with the poached eggs, chickpeas, and same bread. My drink was the iced Black Sesame Latte with almond milk, and it was refreshing, nutty, and not too sweet. Also, I ordered a couple of pastries to-go, including the Black Sesame Frangipane Danish and Calamansi Poppy Seed Brioche. Both pastries were delicious, but I preferred the latter more because the calamansi filling was prominent and the brioche was light & airy.

Great place, got lucky- very small line. Really cool interior with upstairs seating.  Very well decorated and maintained- the service is great.  Tons of people working around you. Got a short rib breakfast burrito - we will see!

Loved the brunch here!! We arrived around 11am on a Saturday and the line was only about 15 min long. We got the French toast as well as the potato leek soup/grilled cheese/salad combo. The French toast was extremely buttery but very delicious and filling. We also loved how the grilled cheese had caramelized onions in it. The black sesame latte I got was also spectacular, perfect level of creaminess and sweetness. I'd come back to try more brunch items!

Avocado toast was great, highly recommend it. Kimchi fried rice was ok but not a good dish for brunch, it's heavy so it's more for dinner or so. Regular latte was good. The Viet coffee/latte was just the regular with condensed milk, not recommend this one. Be aware of 4% team benefits and for large party adding 20% gratitude charge.  Everything added up; it's quite pricey for brunch.

First, I totally understand why this is such a highly reviewed spot in LA. It's worth the hype! We had the Breakfast Sandwich, French Toast, and Potato Pancake with Salmon (a must!!). We also ordered a number of pastries to go. If you are looking for your next place for brunch - this is a no-brainer. (Be prepared to wait around 20-30 min before you get a table).

Start to finish our experience at République was exceptional! The cocktails were so refreshing after being out in the heat. My favorite was the snap pea, spirit forward without being overpowering. We shared quite a few different dishes, the bluefin tuna toast with caviar, the Kumamoto oysters, the baguette, Dover sole, and the zucchini & basil risotto. Everything, even down to the baguette was beyond expectations. The Dover sole was expertly deboned tableside, light flaky buttery perfection! The fresh truffle portion on the risotto was generous & really boosted the flavor profile. Our server, the manager, every staff member we interacted with was kind and attentive. Epic meal, so glad we had the chance to try it during our visit!
I just love that their mint tea is actually whole miint leaves in a pot,it looks so pretty!

10/10 would recommend. Ambiance, food, service were all spectacular. You will need to valet at this location unless you find street parking. The building is really unique and older, definitely fits the vibe of the restaurant. At the front of the restaurant, you can watch the chef's cook thru the windows.

Line may be long outside but it goes by quick. Came around brunch time on a sunday but didn't have to wait much at all! We self seated ourselves and they served to our table via the cup number. We ordered: - benedict sandwich: more filling than it looks, one of the best benedict's I've ever had. was surprised not many people ordered this! - croque madame: suuuper filling and savory. Love the seasoned salad that came with it as well, cut the grease of the sandwich perfectly. Apparently this place was owned/designed by Charlie Chaplin, the interior is beautiful. Definitely a tourist spot but I would come back!

This place has a reputation that stands on excellence. I have ordered desserts from here for all occasions for years and I pride myself in being a loyal customer . Until today . It is Easter Sunday and I ordered a banana crème pie that i remember to be big fluffy, generous and beautiful. To my shock it's flat and the size of something you'd get premade in your frozen section. I never before ordered from them and got something so ridiculous. I'm off to another bakery to find dessert for my lunch in 2 hours.

Wonderful! I was half expecting to be disappointed because it's so popular but Republique exceeded my expectations. We came by during the late morning around 11am on a holiday week. There was a long line outside, but it moves quickly. It does feel a bit rushed when you finally get inside because the pastries ALL look amazing, and if it's busy, there's a lot of people inside this small entry space. Someone behind the pastry counter will take your pastry order, then you go to a cashier who takes your order for any menu items. This is also explained by the person behind the pastry counter. We got a few pastries including the banana bread, pumpkin muffin, and almond croissant. We took these home and ate them later. They were all absolutely delicious. For our menu items, we ordered the breakfast sandwich, potato cake, french toast, and quiche. Everything was fantastic. The quality of the items is excellent. Each item also has something that stands out. For example, the brioche french toast is fluffy and decadent. The bfast sandwich is small and simple, but the bun is crispy and egg is perfectly runny. The quiche was light and smooth. The potato cake beautiful and filling. Everything was memorable. We also ordered an iced latte and hojicha latte. The hojicha was a bit too sweet for me. It's also small. The regular latte was a good size and delicious. Overall, the pastries feel like a good value along with the iced latte. However, the menu items are expensive, as was the hojicha latte. Overall, it was absolutely worth a visit, and I wouldn't hesitate to come back. It can be pricey, but worth it in my opinion. A few more notes... after you order, you look for a seat. We sat on the patio which was almost empty because it was drizzly that day. But there's some light mesh covering and we had our dog with us, so outside was perfect. The outdoor patio is dog friendly during the morning/afternoon hours, but not for dinner. Service was great overall too. Parking is a mix of residential and meters. Make sure you look at the plethora of signs if you park in the residential area. Mostly be aware if it is 1-2 hour limit or street sweeping.

Very cute and aesthetic restaurant! A fun place to be with friends. It seems to always be packed with a line out the door, and you line up to pay at the front before finding seats on your own. Food is definitely on the pricey side, expect to pay $20-50 for main dishes. I got the breakfast burger which I thought wasn't bad but nothing spectacular, it used a pork belly sausage and had a raw egg on top. The fingerling potatoes were ok, flavor was good but was hoping it would be crispier. The hojicha latte was decent as well. We got 3 desserts to share, the one I liked the most was the pandan coconut cookie (the texture was perfect).
Still a favorite breakfast place Loving the new Turkish egg dish The pastries are always on point Cold brew is delicious too- not too acidic

Loved brunch here! We got the croque madam, kimchi rice, and corned beef hash. Also the Vietnamese latte, caffe mocha, a creme brûlée bombolini, banana salted caramel bombolini, and strawberry cream Cheese pop tart. AMAZING. Their pastries are super reasonably priced- $2-5 for the majority of them. Everything was delicious. We got here at 9:40 and there was a 20 minute line. The valet is free on weekends until 11am by the way which is nice.

Well, all it takes a quick look and drive by and you see the long line coming out the front door. I guess it must be a great place for Breakfast, Brunches, lunches. It's a tight place to get in, maneuver around the cashiers, seats, and the open kitchen. Also, it takes patience for sure. Wait to order, wait to seat, wait for your food and beverages. And for a party of 4 the food and drinks also arrived at different time, which made it not so exciting as we waited for one another to enjoy the food together. The taste, presentation, and amenities including the dish-ware were all above average and made your mood more joyful. Many worker roam around too, I guess to pick the dirty dishes and clean the table to make it ready for the next customers. Hut your table is not individually waited on.  So you need salt and pepper, another jog of water, more napkins, you are better off just getting up and grabbing it yourself. Those are all available on the tables by the kitchen areas. However, the experience takes away from you just enjoying your company and conversations. So, why so many people love this place! IDK! I liked it but as you see in my write up, they can be much more organized and more customer friendly. I finally flagged a worker with tray speeding by asking, well felt like pleading, to take our dirty dishes, and he took 1/2 of them and never came back. Perhaps, they don't want you to get used to their help!  I didn't like it. Also, Valet parking $14 and they apparently drove my car off the lot as the adjacent space is tight and small. I didn't like that either. I still give them 4-Star as the food was very good and plentiful.

The people who work here are super patient and kind. W disabilities sometimes I need explaining with tech related things and they were super patient and treated me with extreme kindness the pizza smells amazing and look forward to eating it. Thank you again for your kindness and patience it means a lot. If you go here you will be in good hands

Thank you for taking the time to share your experience! We're thrilled you enjoyed your visit and appreciate your kind words. Your feedback helps us continue delivering the quality service our customers expect. We look forward to seeing you again soon. -Lou's Guest Services

Absolutely loved this pizza. First deep dish I've had in years and when visiting Chicago I knew I'd have to get some. The crust was crispy, the sausage was juicy and delicious, and the cheese pull was insane! I was stuck between here and pequods but this place was closer and there wasn't a line so that was clutch. The inside was super clean and nice with an old school type feeling. Service was okay over the phone- I asked for 18 crushed red peppers because there was 9 of us and the lady who answered was just like "yeah I'm not giving you 18. I'll give you 10." I was like wellll alright then. She was right tho we didn't end up using all 10 Service was good upon arrival and most important thing was how delicious that deep dish pizza was. Perfectly balanced with sauce to crust to meat ratio I'd 10/10 recommend and want a frozen one sent to me

Bucktown Lou's is top-notch. I went here on a VERY busy football night, it was packed, and the employees could not have been more organized, composed, kind, fast, efficient, and happy to serve. The wait was not too bad, they moved so fast to get everyone what they needed and their composure even caused us waiting to happily have patience and all was well! I got my pizza, went on my way, and enjoyed a delicious sausage, pepperoni, and mushroom thin crust! Well done, Lou's Buckdown for earning both a touchdown and field goal on both service and deliciousness!
Thank you for taking the time to share your experience with us. We're delighted you had a positive experience. -Lou's Guest Services

This was my 2nd visit to Chicago so I had to try a different version of deep dish! Previously I had Pequod's and found that not tasty at all as the pizza was all bread, had a strong yeast taste and literally absorbed the sauce into the bread! Lou Malnati's I found much better! The contrast of bread to toppings and sauce was done very well and I see why people say it's one of the best! I've tried Giordano's but in Vegas and it was a small portion so I will have to give that 1 more shot to see who is the winner but I can agree that Lou Malnati's is a brand you can trust! Not to mention they are everywhere!

We've been ordering delivery from this location for years and they never disappoint. The pizzas are always delivered hot and amazing. Their deep dish is king, but their thin crust is also so good and so crispy! I recommend ordering buttercrust and all pizzas well done. The people who work there are cool too, nice service.
Ordered delivery: a Chicago special deep dish, uncut well done. It arrived a soaking mess, with the sauce and sausage too small for the pie it sat on. Really unappetizing.

I know that some things happen and that could be fixed but waiting and not be told for any type of updates on an order is very rude. I am a delivery person. Uber eats. I waited at the pick up two delivery orders. The girls there was glasses, supposed to come back and let me know. How long is it gonna be finally I spoke to her and she told me that there were some kind of messed up orders. everything was packed up, but I would at least appreciate being told not waiting there 30 minutes so I had to cancel the orders because I had a ready order in my car that I had to deliver to another client and when I cancel orders on my Uber Eats app, it brings down my points not fair there

I needed a new pizza spot because the last 2 times I visited a Giordano's location; they just didn't have that signature buttery crust flavor I fell in love with. Lou Malnati was the spot I opted for and what a great  choice I made.  I ordered my pizza online and picked it up on my drive back to St Louis.  The pizza was hot and delicious. Everything was how I asked ie uncut and light on the sauce. Their pizza dough, mozzarella cheese, and pizza sauce do not contain any alcohol.  Lou Malnati's mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese, and romano cheese are all made with a vegetable rennet, not an animal rennet. If you're in Chicago ,check them out.

Got so many recs to come to a branch of this pizza shop when in Chicago and I'm glad a fellow pizza lover and I went to check it out! This particular location can be really hard to find (before the brick entrance thing) because it's really small and hidden in a corner so we had to circle the area a couple of times but the people that work there were so fun and lively! While this place does sound like the Illuminati, the only mystical part about it is how they made their pizza so delicious! If you're in the Chicago area and are looking for a place to experience your pizza fix, would definitely recommend checking this place out!
Our first stop every time we visit Chicago. Best deep dish in town. Get the buttercrust!
Perfect deep dish, and garlic bread! We got delivery and it was super fast and good was super hot.
Thank you for the positive feedback, Candi S! We're glad you enjoyed our deep dish pizza and garlic bread.

Came to Chicago for the first time and was told this place was a no-brainer to visit. Their deep-dish is amazing and definitely not doughy like Giordanos or other deep dished pizza some can be. Their appetizers were amazing, too! Our favorite was their chicken wings and fried zucchini and mushrooms (definitely order their appetizer sampler). We didn't take pics of their pizza but we ordered their small pizzas to share with 3 people was fulfilling enough with only like one slice leftover! The 'Malnati Chicago Classic' and 'The Lou' pizza are a must get when you're eating here!

The Lou Deep Dish pizza was really good lots of flavor, I also love veggies so it was perfect. Wasn't as deep as I pictured for a deep dish pizza but the great service and the flowerbeds on the outdoor patio made it worthwhile

Thank you for taking the time to share your experience with us. We truly appreciate your feedback and are glad you enjoyed your visit. Your input helps us continue improving our service and providing the best possible experience for our customers.-Lous Guest Services

You cant go to Chicago without trying their famous deep dish pizza! I've heard from locals and tourists that this is the place to go. We tried to go (but it was so packed) before our fancy Michelin starred dinner and I'm really glad we didn't because BOY were these filling! So we came bright (11 AM) instead and had no problems finding a table. We had the Malnati Chicago Classic and added hot giardiniera. It came out pipping hot and FULL of meat. The cheese was perfect and stringy and the hot giardiniera had a perfect amount of heat. A small had 4 thicc slices so we were soooo full at the end. We also had the malnati salad which had romaine lettuce, bruschetta tomatoes, black olives, mushrooms, salami bits and gorgonzola cheese with sweet vinaigrette and romano cheese- This is one of the best salads I've had in a while We even carried 4 of these in frozen version and smuggled them across the boarder! I definitely recommend adding this to your Chicago eats!

This was a well-known pizza place that we saw online before our trip to Chicago, and I have to say that I'm really glad I came here! Pre-covid, this place was really crowded and so we had to wait a while to be seated. The inside can fit a decent number of people, and the servers there were pretty nice and welcoming. For the food, this pizza is hands-down the best deep-dish pizza that I've had so far. The portion sizes are huge (as expected from deep-dish), with thick crust that's crispy and hot. The flavors are great, with a ton of sauce and cheese that make it an excellent pizza. It comes pretty hot so be careful to not burn your tongue, but after that the pizza is thoroughly enjoyable and one of the best overall pizzas I've had. Overall, while the wait may be long it's definitely worth it to try one of the best deep-dish places in Chicago!

Ordered the Malnati deep dish pizza and it was just ok. The sauce was extremely watery and was all over the cardboard box. The sausage on the pizza isn't crumbled but instead a thick layer of sausage on the entire pizza. Giordanos is much better and they have a meatlovers option on the menu instead of a think layer of sausage. Will not return.

Hi Mag , we are sorry you had a disappointing experience with us and that your pizza wasn't our best quality. Thank you for bringing this to our attention! Please send your feedback to https://www.loumalnatis.com/contact so we can hear from you more directly. We are looking forward to hearing from you and truly appreciate your patience with us. Best, Emily Goetz Lou Malnati's Pizzeria

I regrettably ordered a personal pizza, which I've read from other reviewers is a no-no if you want the traditional deep dish flavor. I left Lou Malnati's thinking maybe I just didn't like deep dish, but then had Pequod's the following day and changed my mind. While the butter crust is indeed buttery, I don't think the pizza is nearly as flavorful as it could be. I love cheese that is almost or partially burnt and a doughy bread, but if your preferences are different, Lou Malnati's could be the one for you!
Thank you Madison, appreciate your feedback!

So happy with my experience here! My friend and I are visiting Chicago and all of our friends recommended this place for delicious deep dish pizza. Boy did they live up to expectations! The staff was so kind and could tell it was our first time there. They guided through how to order, and even gave us tips on how to have our pizza cooked and how to get the most bang for our buck! I will totally be recommending this place to anyone I know visiting Chicago

Dear Erin, Greetings! We are thrilled to hear that you had such a positive experience at Bucktown - Lou Malnati's Pizzeria. Thank you so much for taking the time to share your feedback with us. It's always rewarding to know that our staff made you feel welcome and provided you with helpful guidance during your visit. We pride ourselves on delivering the best deep dish pizza in Chicago, and we're glad that we lived up to your expectations. We truly appreciate your recommendation and will be more than happy to welcome anyone you know visiting Chicago. If you have any further questions or need assistance in the future, please don't hesitate to reach us at (773) 395-2400. Thank you again for your kind words, Erin! We hope to serve you some delicious pizza again soon. Best regards, Bucktown - Lou Malnati's Pizzeria

Lou's is a staple in Chicago; great convenient pizza that you can't really go wrong with. I always prefer their tavern style but always a great go to for parties. Service is quick and affordable prices.
Thank you for the 5 star review Scott! Have a great week!!

TL;DR: This review is in regards to their frozen pizza! I really wanted to bring some good pizza back home to my friends. I've heard good things about Lou Malnati's and wanted to give this place a try. My belly was full to the brim with deep dish, so I knew I couldn't eat anymore at that very moment. We found out that this pizza shop sells frozen pizza that you can even fly back home with! SCORE! I ordered the veggie and the sausage pizza. MY GAHHHH....the pizza was sooooo darn good. I'm so happy I got to try Lou Malnati's at the comfort of my home in Los Angeles!

Came back to Chicago after a trip to NYC and was unfortunately disappointed by the pizza representation. I ordered the "Lou" with a few extra toppings. I am not the big deep dish fan but had heard great things about the thin crust pizza here. Sadly it did not even get close to the bar, let alone meet it. To my dismay the pizza, a personal, was much smaller than I expected. Typically single pizzas are at least 8-10 " diameter. I asked for the pizza to be well done for crispier edges which did help make it crunchy, but the middle of the pizza was undercooked. Somehow the entire pie was flavorless and lacked any interesting texture besides mushy. Hope to come back another time and give some of their other specialties a chance, but I definitely had heightened expectations going into it.

Amazing! Friends kept recommending we go here while in Chicago and it did not disappoint. If travel had been easier, I would've taken a frozen one home! I liked this much better than other deep dish pizza I tried in Chicago.

We stopped here on Wednesday, November 6, as we were heading back home to Des Moines. Plan was to pick up some pizzas to take back to Iowa to heat up at home.  We got there 5 minutes after they opened, and we were greeted by a very helpful, friendly and professional gent. I wanted to mention the date, as I didn't get his name, but he was a great representative of this Malnati's location. A tip of the hat to this guy. We took four pies to go, and just finished the last one this week.  We took sausage and cheese pizzas home with us.  They were all awesome. The dough is so beautifully delicate with the perfect amount of crunch and a slight sweetness. Great sauce and the sausage was impressive. Wish there was a Malnati's in this town! Remember, you can order Malnati's on goldbelly website. I've ordered them to be delivered to those friends who you really love.

After being told "Maybe I am having a bad night" by a supervisor when waited 15 mins without anyone saying anything to me or given my change after payment...I am positive there are better places near Damen and Milwaukee to get pizza from. The pizza is a 5 star pizza but the customer service or rather lack of it this evening makes this place a "not worth it". Before anyone jumps on me about giving the workers a break I will say thats BS bc there were 4 employees in the front all standing around socializing, looking down, and purposely not talking to anyone in the lobby.  If the preference is curbside pick up ....as stated on their own website...then why on this evening none of the employees were going out delivering to the cars? Maybe this place is only good when delivered...as my initial review was for their delivery. Two stars .... bc while the pizza is great I have had waaaaay better interaction getting my food.
Thank you for writing a review! I am happy to hear you had a great experience and enjoyed our pizza. We look forward to serving you again soon! Cheers, Nicole Malnati Organization, Inc.

So good!! Ordered the bruschetta and it was still crispy when delivered!! The delivery man was on time, courteous and put pizza pie a work of art. The veggie deep dish was great! I always did love Lou's

We've been enjoying stuffed spinach pizzas since living here for a year back in the '80's. Lou's is a good solid Chicago stuffed pizza with its own special taste and texture. Always good, always fresh. We did delivery for this one and it arrived ahead of schedule (45 minutes) and the extra marina sauce was great. A large fed 6 moderately hungry adults so made a pretty affordable dinner for travel weary folks. Even the 4-year old enjoyed a piece. In retrospect I think the Lou's Special would be preferred. But the regular spinach was hard to beat.
Good deep dish option. The sauce was ok but we got The Lou which lacked the savory flavor. Easy to order and easy to pick up at this carry out only location.
We got the Malnati Chicago Classic and Deep Dish the Lou. Both of them were so good! My only thing is that the sauce is a bit runny.

I mean, between all the deep dish I've had, Lou's ain't the worst but I honestly liked Gino's east in Miracle mile better.  I hated Giordanos, and Lois is just okay... All this being said, the style of pizza is generally trash, I'm a New Yorker and you're all lesser humans for liking this casserole crap. Lol

Pandemic precautions: Online orders only with curbside pick-up. Customer service: 3/5 Food was not ready in time. Small customized deep dish: 5/5 Very good, love pizza from lou malnati's. Always get buttercrust. Caesar salad: 5/5 Decent and basic salad, but the delicious fatty dressing is whats up.
Terribel attitude and behavior from pick up side. The guys literally creamy to customer as well as delivery drivers. Fire this guy!
We apologize for the behavior you experienced. Please contact us at (773) 395-2400 to discuss this further.
Perfect pizza and pasta right on the money. Great service definitely recommend Chicago staple.

Cleanliness: 3 Quality: 5 Service: 5 Taste: 4 All fresh ingredients. The pizza was cooked perfectly and tasted great! The sausage in the Malnati wasn't a hit with us because we aren't sausage lovers but overall a delicious tasting pizza! The Lou was a  perfect vegetable medley! The quality of ingredients here is evident in the taste and overall outcome! Loved it!

The Netflix depiction of Lou's is right on the money! I have been  saying that since before l stop ordering from you guys.  It's just not pizza! No cheese for a deep dish! A joke!  It's Just a blob of "cement like mass"! I never got a refund for the crappy pizzas  I received. So take it now,! Is the exact description of what you served! Sorry . I miss Lous it went to crap!

This location has been constantly declining in consistency. I order a deep dish pizza with spinach Friday night and what l received was basically crust, a hint of spinach and a smear of tomato sauce. This pizza was so meager l had to grab some slices of cheese out of  my fridge and also some olive oil to give it some moisture. Really enjoy their pizza and this place offers the both take out or delivery. You can customize the pizza if you call or order on their application and I have enjoyed their thin crust plus their promotions. These last times, they do curb side pick up so they do come out to know what you are picking up and they will bring it out to you. They have free parking and you may walk up to pickup.  Will come back.
Thank you for your review, Miguel. We are happy to hear you enjoyed your pizza and had a great experience with our team while picking up your pizza. We look forward to serving you again soon!

Really enjoy their pizza and this place offers the same for take out or delivery.  You can customize their pizza and I have enjoyed their thin crust. This last time I picked up my pizza and the lady at the register was warm and friendly. They have free parking as well. Will come back.

Ordered carryout from this location the other day. It was a quick process to order our pizza online and scheduled the pick up. We arrived a few minutes after the scheduled pick up time. This particular location has limited parking spots and the lobby was currently closed. An associate (with a mask on) walked out and asked for the name on the order.  Upon giving her the name on the order, she retrieved our order and handed it to us all while we were standing outside. We ordered a small original deep dish and it was delicious. The pizza stayed hot and the crust was still crispy when we ate it about 15 minutes after picking it up. The sauce was very flavorful and had a good depth. Although it was very filling, it didn't leave me feeling like I had eaten way too much. The small was perfect for two people to share.

Lou Malnati's is the franchise king of deep dish pizza in Chicago. This is a take out only location. Limited time, private parking lot. Cannot walk around if you park here. Ordered over the phone. Took 20 minutes to bake. Did not want to have to sit around waiting for it to cook. They have a freezer section to buy bake at home pies. Chicago Classic, personal - $9.95 - Comes with sausage. Crust is thick, good crisp, and super buttery. Still a good size for me and the wifey to share, you get bored and full fast eating a lot of this.
Delicious. Looks like the photos. Our cheese pull was truly exciting. The roasted tomatoes tasted sweet and the cheese was baked to stringy perfection.
Love Chicago pizza when I am in town. Try a new place every time  purchased a couple to take back with me
One of my favorite pizza places in Chicago. I also love their Lou salad and dressing.

Before my flight from LA I posted asking where the best spot in Chicago to eat were for deep dish. When I landed I saw a whole lot of responses for Lou's. Long story short we pulled up directly from the airport. Our server Frankie was so on point with the knowledge. She let us know not only the best food to try but also the history behind the place and the food. Very impressed with the food, it was so good I cried, on camera, no lie. Bruh, if you in Chicago you gotta go here.
This is the best Lou's in the city low key. You can smell it from 3-4 blocks away. Fast, friendly and make the best wings and salads. I love you Lou!
Very family oriented I suppose. Too many meat options . Not alit of love for vegans :(

I'd eat here weekly if I could. Lou's is money and this location does a great job with carry out. The pizza is fresh, buttercrust always excellent, and it always nails the signature Lou's flavor. The Lou's salad is an unsung hero of this Chicago institution as well. Huge portions, great dressing, everything you could ask for!
A Chicago classic!! One of the best deep dish options according to locals. This specific location is to-go only but food comes out quickly. Great deep dish and salads.

The food was excellent, as always. There were lots of toppings and I felt like I got my money's worth. The woman working the counter was very kind and helpful. I loved her customer service skills, as she made me feel welcomed and comfortable while we were waiting for our food. Excellent place!

Well we are visiting from Detroit. Great pizzerias there. But Chicago has a rep for pizza that sets the bar. Ordered from Lou's. About an hour to get it delivered. Expected wait time for a good pie and wings in the city. Spent all day in the car and the 4 of us were starving. Killed the chicken wings immediately. Sauce was awesome. Pizza wasn't cut. That's odd I specified for a cut since we are in an Air BNB and do not know what we have. Cut into the pizza and started to eat. It was vegetarian and had the 2 things one of my kids hate... tomatoes and mushrooms. Now don't get me wrong, the pizza was good. My wife thoroughly enjoyed it. It just wasn't my order. Thankfully I saw the name on the receipt and it wasn't me. Gave them a call and they are going to make it right in about an hour. So at least I will be able to have the pie I ordered and my kid will get to enjoy pizza. After 6 hours in the car he's a little hangry. So until I can review the pie I ordered, you get 3 stars. See you in an hour and then maybe will get more stars. Ok 30 minutes later my pizza arrived. It looks like the original order. May have intercepted the delivery driver before he dropped it off to the wrong house. I'll give you 1 more for a total of 4. Pizza was luke warm. Crust is rock hard. Had the original order number on it. I was told it would be a remake. I don't mean to be a jerk but it it what it is. For $34 I did expect more flavor. But it is a good pie. For a laugh, the driver called and o came down and her was at the house across the street. He was tying. Don't want to make me him feel bad. It made me laugh though. Mistakes happen.

The pizza is only ok. I'm taking time out to write a negative review because the delivery driver has made me very uncomfortable. He has called me multiple times on my personal number asking if I want to talk to him more. Very strange behavior.
Does not answer the phone. Complete ghost on the order. Not good enough food to deal with that

Out-of-towners and first-timers over here so we didn't realize this was the carry out location. But the lady at the counter is super nice, we ordered the Chicago classic, per her suggestion. It was totally worth the 30 minute wait. Cheese was gooey, sausage was delicious, crust was crispy and buttery. Amazing! My only suggestion- call ahead lol
Thank you for your review, Sarina! We are happy to hear you enjoyed your pizza and had a great experience with us. We look forward to serving you again soon!

No, I do NOT recommend this business.  The STAFF gave me attitude and hurled false and SLANDEROUS accusations at me.  I do not need THAT.  The pizza wasn't "burned" so I'm giving two stars instead of ONE, which these nasty people, whom belong with other NASTY people at "Jenny's" "ice cream", DESERVE.  Do YOURSELF a favor: Get your Lou Malnatis pizza at JEWEL!

This Lou's spot offers delivery and carry-out/takeout... and it's great! The service is always, always, always friendly. Their delivery drivers (who are actual Lou's employees!) are so nice and the COVID-19 contact-free delivery comes with a quick phone call letting you know where they put your pizza ( we come to the window to wave to them as well). And, if you have an issue or question, just give them a call and they are *happy* to help! I've only had an issue one time in about 10+ years, and they were super kind and helpful. A lot of places offer gluten free pizza, but Lou's is the one pizza place that serves gluten free pizza and I haven't ever gotten sick from their food (I know, I know... knocks on wood). I also have a child with several severe anaphylactic food allergies, and Lou's is phenomenally good with helping him eat safely, too. They go above and beyond. If you have any questions, their website is extremely helpful and transparent about what's is in your food with an allergen section and what safety precautions they take. As always, do talk to them (call or in-person) - as I said above, they are friendly and very helpful. As an aside, Lou's doesn't have any peanuts or tree nuts in their kitchens. And it's easy to eat vegan/plant-based because their regular crust is vegan naturally - just order a pizza without cheese! (Gluten free crusts contain egg, fyi). I am also a huge fan of their salads. They are super fresh and crunchy - and huge! So sometimes I get just a salad and it is fantastic. The Italian ice is amazing as well, especially during the summer for a treat!

True authentic Chicago deep dish was the only reason why I came to Chicago. Just kidding...kinda. I heard/read the amazing reviews of Lou Malnati's pizza and I couldn't wait to try it for myself. Being my first meal in Chicago, the pizzeria really set the tone for the great food I would eat during the rest of my visit. We ordered 2 large pizzas for 6 people, which was wayyyy too much food. I think we would have been fine with 2 medium pizzas. We ordered The "Lou" and The Malnati Chicago Classic. The "Lou" was good, but was nothing compared to The Malnati Chicago Classic. The Lou is vegetarian, but every bite I took I wish there was meat. The Malnati Chicago Classic was absolutely delicious. Every bite of pizza was filled with delicious cheesiness and sausage. The sausage on this pizza wasn't just clumps of sausage, Lou Malnati uses sausage patties! I wish every pizza joint did this. The only downside that we didn't figure out until we got there was that this location is carry-out/ delivery only. Regardless, my friends and I took our pizzas and ate at Wicker Park. My only regret is that we only had Lou Malnati's pizza once while in Chicago.

I do not like deep dish pizza. What I do like is that there is lots of cheese on it. The tomato on top is a kill for me. The salads were really good The Gorgonzola dressing was excellent. The medium salad is big enough for 3 maybe 4 people. The pizza just has a really dry feel to it. Could use some sauce on the bottom. The personal size was almost inedible it was so dry. Usually adding pepperoni makes a pizza more moist this was not the case for this pizza. That was my take on it. The rest of the family says it was good but also did not like the tomatoes on the top. They would get it again while I would not. I am east coast thin crust all the way

Horrible service . Also when I called they hang up twice. This was so unprofessional. The order was completely wrong! The guy at the front was rude! Also he charge me for dressing. No one should go there, Horrible

Delicious- did not disappoint.  The cheese and the tomato sauce on the malnati special was out of this world flavor.  Don't be fooled by the circumference of the pizza- one slice of a medium is filling and all each of us could eat.  Wish I lived closer to enjoy this more often

Pizza by the secretive Illuminati's (as the locals say it) was rather misleading in their description of Deep Dish. I had Giordanos last time in Chicago and that was double the depth of this pie (I have pics to support)!  Locals said this was place to go, but I say nah. Was thick as normal Cleveland pizza, but less tasty.  Crust was dry & not buttery. Workers were nice, good service.

For anyone who has not had Lou Malnati's, you must first try the deep dish with just cheese. Ask for uncut if delivery and add butter crust if you really want to do it up.  This pizza will fill you up! The tomatoes are somewhat chunky but are sweet and melt in your mouth.  They do a great job with their sauce to tone down the acidity. The cheese is amazing and melds perfectly into the fluffy crust with their unique sauce. You can expect that most guests will have two slices then tap out.  The gutsy ones will go for three but will need a long nap after.
Thank you for your review, Brian! We are happy to hear you enjoyed your pizza and had a great experience with us. We look forward to serving you again soon!

Just so you know I for the frozen pie shipped shipped out to the West Coast. It was expensive but I wanted to get that taste so bad I didn't care The sauce was great but the meats and crust just didn't do it for me. So it's not a knock on a fresh made pie just know if you are expecting the same thing in  getting a frozen one, well It ain't gonna happen Later

An a-okay yum! This was my first experience with deep dish pizza, and pizza in Chicago! It was tasty, and if you like deep dish this is the place for you. Overall I enjoyed my experience, but be prepared to wait. I think in total we were there for 3 hours? Including waiting for a table/waiting for food/eating. Part of me feels like it's worth it -- a staple in Chicago food PLUS it was yummy. However, I don't know if I could do that wait a second time. Overall, good pizza. There's a reason a lot of people go here! ALSO very reasonable prices!
My first time to Chicago so I had to try the most famous style in the world, It was amazing. The food and the service !!! Love It
Best Pizza ever tasted and I'm not much of a pizza fan, tried the thin crust jalapeño and salad amazing!

The pizza may be good, but after waiting 2 hours for delivery, it was limp soggy and greasy.  Original estimate was an hour to 75 minutes.  Irritating factor was watching the app say that my pizza was only a minute away for 30 minutes.  Calling the restaurant was futile.  Told to sit tight "they were sure" pizza would be there soon.  Pizza was so unappealing, I wound up scrambling eggs for dinner. Won't make this mistake again.

Really disappointed with the thin crust here. Asked for well done and it came super floppy and the crust was borderline undercooked. On top of that the cheese had no flavor and felt plasticy. This reminded me of a frozen home run in pizza when you pull it out 5 minutes too early. For the price very disappointing. I'd take costcos pizza over this thin crust. Maybe the deep dish is better or I just ordered on a off night

Avoid Wicker Park location! Was very watery with no flavor. Ordered classic deep dish and the "Lou" deep dish. Tastes like a frozen pizza that was thrown in the oven. Crust was very mushy and I can't stress enough how it tasted just like water. Also, it's carry out only. Only go to the Michigan Ave location.

Pros: It was edible. Sauce was unique, chunky. Cheese was tasty... there was sample pizza out to try while waiting for your takeout. Unfortunately it was not vegitarian friendly but still a nice gesture. Cons: I've had other Chicago deep dish pizzas before and I have read the other reviews about the crust here .. but it was more like a tall edge/flat/thin center crust, and it was disappointing. For the price I would have expected a pile of sauce and a ton of cheese on some fluffy crust, but I was super disappointed. I can go elsewhere and get a slice or two of actual deep dish pizza for under or about ten bucks. Also, if I wanted flat pizza, I would have ordered thin crust. Th size I ordered was a personal- which must mean child sized... I'm only 5'2" and the pizza was smaller than my hand. Not enough food for the price and not great enough to justify said price. I had to grab food elsewhere in order to satisfy my hunger. Verdict: I won't be coming back here. 2 stars because of uniqueness that I didn't appreciate.
